input.title: Women's Christian – Jesus, Light of the World Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

This light of the world hoodie carries JESUS and LIGHT OF THE WORLD for women who wear their faith to church, small group and the Christmas Eve candlelight service.

A rustic oil lantern glows with a single flame, wheat and wildflowers growing at its base. JESUS stands above in heavy brown serif letters and LIGHT OF THE WORLD runs full width below, a nod to John 8:12.

Pull it on for Sunday morning, Advent evenings and cold walks home from service. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Sport Grey
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

What colors does it come in?
The Women's Christian Jesus, Light of the World hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. comes in Sand and Sport Grey. The brown JESUS and LIGHT OF THE WORLD letters and the golden lantern all read clearly on both light blanks, so every word stays easy to read from the pew.

Is it a good gift for a Christian woman?
Yes. The Jesus, Light of the World hoodie gives a woman of faith a sincere design for church and Advent, on an 8 oz 50/50 fleece that is warm for winter services. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order; order by about December 8 for Christmas delivery with free US shipping over $45.

How does the Light of the World hoodie fit?
The Graphic Tees Co. Light of the World hoodie is a classic unisex pullover cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one size for a roomier, cozier fit over a long-sleeve layer on a cold church morning.

How do I care for it?
Machine wash this Graphic Tees Co. hoodie cold, inside out, with similar colors, then tumble dry low. The 8 oz 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece is pre-shrunk, and washing inside out keeps the brown lettering and the glowing lantern looking sharp season after season.

Where does the print sit?
The Light of the World print sits across the chest above the front pouch pocket, about ten inches wide, with JESUS on top, the lantern in the middle and LIGHT OF THE WORLD underneath. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order on the front only.
